quiz.question: What primary force pulls the rocket back toward Earth until thrust exceeds weight?
quiz.explanation: Gravity pulls every object toward Earth's center at ~9.8 m/s².

quiz.question: According to Newton's Third Law, how does a rocket engine propel the craft forward?
options: By pushing against the launch tower
By expelling high-speed exhaust gas downward, creating an equal upward thrust
By suction created in the vacuum of space
By reflecting light off the rocket skin
quiz.explanation: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction! Hot expanding gas exiting downward pushes the rocket upward.

quiz.question: Why do rockets shed empty fuel tanks during multistage launch?
options: To make room for astronauts to walk outside
To discard dead weight so remaining fuel can accelerate the craft much faster
Because tanks rust instantly in high altitude
To signal ground control with a flash
quiz.explanation: Carrying heavy empty tanks wastes fuel. Shedding dead mass increases the Thrust-to-Weight Ratio drastically!
